title: Streaming + function/tool-call interop audit for newly onboarded model variants
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Run a focused audit to validate token-streaming behavior and function/tool-calling semantics for the set of newly onboarded model variants (v1.2*, quantized variants, and trimmed-sequence flavors). This ticket covers automated CI tests, exploratory manual checks, and publishing the resulting performance/compatibility profile to the model catalog. We must ensure streaming chunking, partial function call payloads, and early tool invocation signals behave identically (or with documented diffs) to our reference model and runtime contracts.
background: During onboarding for the 'falcon-x' family (v1.2 series) we observed divergent behavior when models are served under continuous batching and KV-cache reuse. On a handful of internal smoke runs, function-call 'name' selection was delayed until the last chunk, and some streaming clients dropped tool-call payloads when tokenization boundaries cross micro-batches. Because customers can pin specific model versions, we need a compatibility audit + profile publishing step before marking variants as 'streaming-verified' in the catalog.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic test matrix (see matrix link) executes across all onboarded variants and passes without flaky failures >1% in 30m stress window
Function/tool-calling semantics during streaming match contract: early function-name detection, partial args merging across chunks, and correct final JSON payload assembled
No silent payload drops when streaming under continuous batching with batch sizes up to 16 and token rates simulated up to 2k tokens/sec
Performance profile (latency P50/P95, tail, and cost-per-token under streaming) is published to the model catalog for each variant with clear notes on known behavioral diffs
Automation: add tests to ci/streaming-interop that run in nightly and on PRs for model onboarding changes
test_plan: 1) Build a matrix: model variants x sequence lengths (64, 256, 1024) x batching modes (single, continuous batching, aggressive batching) x client types (http-stream, websocket, grpc). 2) Implement harness that can inject function-call prompts designed to produce mid-stream function_name detection and large JSON args split across micro-batches. 3) Run synthetic load with trace enabled to capture chunk boundaries, kernel-switch logs, and assembled function payloads. 4) Record failure modes and replay failing traces locally. 5) Validate against golden-reference runtime (runtime-1.16 baseline) and annotate catalog behavior notes.
progress_notes: 2025-02-14: Kickoff meeting with runtime, infra, and devx. Defined matrix and initial harness owner (Ravi).
2025-02-15: First harness check-in: http-stream and websocket clients implemented. Early reproducer shows function name delayed until final chunk on quantized-8bit variant.
2025-02-16: Instrumented kernel selection logs; observed kernel path switch when sequence length >512 leading to micro-batch boundary tokenization differences.
2025-02-17: Created PR to ensure function-call assembly logic consults partial-arg buffers across micro-batches (runtime PR #3321).
2025-02-18: Nightly run (1000 synthetic sessions) produced 2.8% failures for quantized-8bit variant under aggressive batching. Investigating whether KV cache reuse contributes.
2025-02-19: Added guard in streaming path to coalesce partial JSON fragments before function-name detection; decreased failure rate to 0.6% in repeat run. Needs code review and perf regression check.

2025-02-20: Design/PM review: agreed to publish profile with 'streaming-verified (beta)' flag for variants with <1% observed failure and documented mitigation steps. Pinned-v1 policy will surface this flag to customers.
open_issues: Occasional 5xx when a streaming client cancels mid-function-call; root cause trace points to incomplete KV cache cleanup (ENG-9178 follow-up)
Quantized variants show 10-25ms extra P95 under coalescing fix — needs perf budget approval from infra
Need to extend the CI matrix to include Dedicated capacity nodes (different kernel selectors) — dependency on ENG-9040
decisions: Ship a temporary catalog flag 'streaming-verified (beta)' rather than blocking onboarding; this allows customers to opt-in and gives us telemetry before full roll-out.
Require automated nightly runs that gate 'streaming-verified' state; threshold set to <1% failure under 30m stress window.
Do not backport the coalescing change to older runtime branches without perf sign-off; will include in runtime-1.19 only initially.
next_steps: Finish PR review for runtime/pull/3321 and merge (owner: Ravi)
Add Dedicated-node test runs to ci/streaming-interop (owner: Kendra)
Publish performance profile artifacts to model catalog and add 'streaming-verified (beta)' flag page copy (owner: PM: Jonas)
Open ENG-9178 to fix KV cache cleanup on streaming cancel paths
Schedule a 1-hour retro after two full nights of telemetry to validate our <1% threshold
review_feedback: Design review (2025-02-18): UX copy for beta flag should explain known diffs and remediation steps. Action: PM to draft.
Security review (2025-02-19): function-call payload coalescing introduces a small window where partial args are buffered; security team requests a limit (2MB) and audit logging — added as follow-up.
Infra review (2025-02-20): coalescing increased memory pressure on aggressive batching; recommend adding telemetry for coalesced buffer sizes and a hard cap.
